messages:
tam: Solaris private deploy dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need final KMS ARN, exact cross-account role name + trust policy (with ExternalId), audit S3 bucket and object-lock status, outbound CIDRs, and internal DNS entry. Please post by 18:00 PT today. Tagging @solaris-sre

deploy-bot: reminder: dry-run job queued for 2026-04-05T16:30:00Z -> job dj-4419. Will post start/completion.

solaris-sre: KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:6677889900:key/solar-7a1b. Cross-account role: RedwoodAccess_Solaris. Audit bucket: s3://solaris-redwood-audit. Object lock: currently ENABLED (legacy) - compliance needs to approve disable. Outbound CIDRs: 10.80.0.0/16 -> 23.45.67.0/24:443 and 10.80.2.0/24 -> 9.9.9.9:53 for internal resolver.

noah: network note from staging: split-horizon returned old VIP for redwood-api.private.solaris. Please add internal A record `redwood-api.private.solaris` -> 10.80.2.33 with TTL=30 so switchover is fast. Also confirm internal resolver honors per-zone overrides.

viv: retention question: Solaris asked for 60d audit retention. We recommend 90d; mark as note for renewal conversation. Customer insists 60d for now. :page_with_curl: 

solaris-sre: we will request compliance sign-off to disable object lock; if denied we can use lifecycle via separate bucket. Also: KMS scheduled rotation in 3 days - we'll postpone rotation until after cutover and add alias `alias/rdw-emergency` pointing at current key as fallback.

tam: can you paste the IAM trust policy you applied for RedwoodAccess_Solaris so we can validate sts:ExternalId? example we expect below.

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/redwood-deploy"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "solaris-ext-314"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

solaris-sre: pasted trust policy but ExternalId is solaris-ext-999 per their security team. We'll update to solaris-ext-314 and paste final policy ARN by EOD.

viv: renewal flag: Solaris is month 10/12 trial. If dry-run completes with <=1 incident we'll hand to sales for renewal discussion (propose Dedicated discount). If >1 incident, escalate. Tagging @sales. :label:renewal

deploy-bot: dry-run started at 2026-04-05T16:30:12Z (dj-4419).

solaris-sre: post-dry-run smoke: healthz OK. Observed one transient 503 on /v1/generate when simulating cold KV cache, recovered on retry. Also one 429 on embeddings during burst then recovered. Logs snippet:
```
[2026-04-05T16:31:05Z] ERROR 503 /v1/generate - kvcache miss fallback
[2026-04-05T16:31:06Z] INFO 200 /v1/generate - retry ok
[2026-04-05T16:31:12Z] WARN 429 /v1/embeddings - burst retry 1 -> 200
```
Opening ticket SOL-101 for cache warmup tuning and SOL-102 for embedding burst policy.

tam: ops please paste smoke command and full output here. Use this command:
`curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://redwood-api.private.solaris/healthz | jq .`

solaris-sre: smoke output: `{ "status": "ok", "uptime_seconds": 6210, "components": {"runtime": "ok", "kv_cache": "warm", "ingest": "ok"} }`

viv: thanks. Renewal risk flagged SOL-101/SOL-102. Ops add mitigation to runbook: pre-warm KV, backoff retries for embeddings, and monitor 5xx during first 30 minutes.

solaris-sre: compliance approved object lock disable via separate RFC; object lock will be disabled on s3://solaris-redwood-audit by 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. Trust policy ExternalId updated to solaris-ext-314 and role ARN: arn:aws:iam::3344556677:role/RedwoodAccess_Solaris. Posting final confirmations here.

tam: great work everyone. We'll hold cutover slot until tomorrow once the above is set. Leaving thread open for any late blockers. :rocket:
